body.interpretation: (1) Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame::NextLocalVar) — the universal UE native exec prologue, byte-identical in shape to the known-good AFortCreativeMoveTool ports (e.g. ServerResetScale 0x1428c4900). (2) Tail-jump to shared tail 0x141d73520: if N = [this+0xc44] <= 0, skip; else zero int32 entries [this+0xc14 + 4*i] for i in [0, N). No return value, no other side effects.

field_proofs: 0xc14 = ResourcesGivenPerRound array, 5 x int32 (0xc14..0xc27): write target of this clear; read by GetResourceGivenPerRound 0x141d84db0 as *(this+0xc14 + e*4) with bound [this+0xc28]; written by SetResourceGivenPerRound 0x141d91000 with the same bound.
0xc28 = int32 entry count for the 0xc14 array: bound check in 0x141d84db0 ('count <= e -> return 0') and 0x141d91000 ('e < count'). Not reflected (field-offset 0xc28 -> []).

0xc44 = int32 entry count for the 0xc30 array: bound in GetResourceGivenToWinnersPerRound 0x141d84dd0 and SetResourceGivenToWinnersPerRound 0x141d91030; ALSO the loop bound of THIS clear (0x141d73526/0x141d73549), an original asymmetry preserved in the .inc. Not reflected (field-offset 0xc44 -> []).

Array sizing: 0xc28-0xc14 = 0x14 (5 int32s) and 0xc44-0xc30 = 0x14 (5 int32s); EFortResourceType has 6 enumerators (Wood..None, values 0..5) so a 5-slot array + shared count field is consistent with index-by-resource-type storage.
All four fields unreflected in 12.60 (evidence.py field-offset returned [] for 0xc14/0xc28/0xc30/0xc44; nearest reflected member DefaultRestockAmmoAmount at 0xc10 ends the reflected block).

remaining_concerns: The four array/count fields are unreflected; the .inc references NativeRecoveredInt32_0xc14[5]/0xc44 which must be declared in AFortCreativeRoundSettings before the manifest can compile (declarations recorded in field_declarations). No raw-memory stand-in is used.

The 0xc44 bound on the PerRound clear (vs the 0xc28 bound of its own getter/setter) is preserved as in the original; if [this+0xc44] could exceed 5 at runtime the original would write past the 5-slot array — the .inc reproduces that exactly (no added cap).
Initial values of the count fields (0xc28/0xc44) were not traced (set elsewhere, e.g. round-start logic); not needed for this body.
